# A04-S21: Leader model

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

Besides, I have had some big breakthroughs the past week. I have 
 succeeded in programming a chatbot on open source software 
 (GPT-neo-20xb), and it works super well. I found one that had 
 built in a translation app to Danish, so therefore it can search the 
 entire model’s knowledge while all output is in Danish. Thus it is just as good 
 as GPT-3 in Danish, if not a bit better!

That means OpenAI can’t shut down the party!

Therefore I have been able to make the political leader itself, who is to 
 be launched on Wednesday. As the concept has developed and become so "Danish", 
 I was finally not in doubt that it had to be:


*https://www.femina.dk/liv/hvis-du-gerne-vil-vaere-topchef-skal-du-overveje-skifte-navn-til-lars
<https://www.femina.dk/liv/hvis-du-gerne-vil-vaere-topchef-skal-du-overveje-skifte-navn-til-lars>*

Welcome to *Leder Lars *!
